fact: Decreto-Lei n.º 45/2026 of 8 October 2026 charges the state-reform ministry's DNME with implementing measures on Dados Abertos and states the government programme's adoption of an open public data policy.
title: Decreto-Lei n.º 45/2026 (Boletim Oficial, I Série, n.º 109)
